proposal.observation: The rejected degree-3 unfolding trial left ring count unchanged but reduced SAM fill by 0.082783 and increased depth NaNs by 0.034137, so it should not be repeated. On the unchanged incumbent, the detected-lines image contains only sparse, fragmented oblique detections while all 10 regularly spaced prompt centres are shown as propagated, indicating reliance on propagation rather than direct joint evidence.
proposal.rule: When ring spacing and count are coherent but oblique line yield is sparse and prompt centres are propagated, apply the ontology's relax-Hough remediation before changing SAM geometry or unfolding.
proposal.rationale: Lowering the oblique Hough accumulator threshold to a moderate in-bounds value should admit more of the visible fragmented joint evidence and reduce dependence on propagated centres. This keeps the unchanged incumbent's successful degree-2 unfolding, exact 10-ring count, and all SAM geometry fixed.
